newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Herdez started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Herdez started as buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Serfin said on Thursday it initiated coverage of food company Grupo Herdez with a buy recommendation.

"The stock trades at a 30 percent discount to its sector's domestic and international average and the company enjoys potential for long-term growth in line with the recovery of the domestic economy," the report said.
The report said the company has seen steady improvements in its operating margin, after lagging demand from the economic crisis of 1995.
"We project the stock price will rise 72.53 percent over the next 18 months in light of an expected recovery in the domestic economy and estimated GDP growth of 5.5 percent," it added.
Serfin estimated earnings per share for the company at 0.58 pesos.
The company's shares stood at 4.65 in midday trading, up 0.29 pesos from Wednesday's close.
